settings.ret_title: Thirty days to send it back
settings.ret_body:
Apparel comes back within thirty days of delivery, unworn, unwashed and in original condition with all original tags attached.

No makeup or deodorant marks, odors, pet hair, stretching or laundering. A return without its tags has $7 deducted from the refund.

Requests after thirty days aren't accepted. Clubs get sixty days; apparel doesn't.

How the refund works

Refunds go out once the item's back and inspected. Return shipping's on you, and original shipping isn't refunded.
settings.del_body:
Orders leave the warehouse in one to two business days. Ground delivery takes a few business days after that, and you get a tracking number as soon as the carrier scans it.

You'll see what shipping costs, and how fast it is, at checkout before you pay. Orders of $195 or more ship free.

Where it ships from

Long Beach, California.

settings.title: Fabric and care
settings.body:
• Fabric 88% polyester, 12% spandex.
  • Stretch Four-way, so it moves the way your swing does.
  • Finish Moisture-wicking, wrinkle-resistant, and UPF 50+, so the back of your neck makes it to the back nine.
  • Care Machine wash cold. Tumble dry low.

settings.title: Shipping and returns
settings.body:
Orders leave Long Beach, California in 1 to 2 business days, and the tracking number shows up as soon as the carrier scans it.

Apparel gets thirty days to come back: unworn, unwashed, tags on. Return shipping's on you.

settings.heading: Swing in it. Stay out after.
settings.body:
Four-way stretch, so the only thing limiting your backswing is your back. It's an athletic fit in 88/12 poly-spandex, it wicks, it's UPF 50+, and it comes out of the bag looking like it didn't spend the morning in one.

Every print is the same shirt underneath. Pick the one you want your buddies roasting you about.
